working_preferences: Assistant performs research, implementation, local checks, packaging and evidence interpretation.
User normally operates GenLayer Studio and GitHub in Android Chrome. Give short numbered steps with exact methods and copyable input.
Keep the live walkthrough bounded. Do not add optional tests after its stop point.
Inspect exact errors and stored state before retries. Preserve successful prior results.
No unrequested external publication or submission. No spending or requests for private keys.
Keep every new project separate from previous code and deployments.
Do not imply local fixtures prove real-model accuracy or network consensus.
For Studio write calls, show every field in its own copyable block, especially task_id. Keep the assigned wallet suffix explicit.
reusable_workflow: Compare three bounded ideas against our existing projects and public prior work; check names; recommend a practical differentiated option.
Verify current official GenLayer APIs and testing guidance; record exact tested dependencies.
Define semantic decision, immutable evidence, explicit review outcomes, deterministic consequence, permissions and limits.
Implement strict output checking, independent validator comparison/audit, bounded malformed-output handling and writes only after accepted evaluation.
Test workflow, invalid output, disagreement, permissions, hashes, replay, isolation and nonmutation on rejected evaluation; distinguish simulated checks.
Package source, tests, research, reproduction instructions, observed evidence and a fixed phone walkthrough.
Run the bounded Studio walkthrough with actual wallets; check execution, consensus and stored state separately.
Document actual evidence. Then prepare GitHub and submission using current official requirements; preserve limitations and do not promise rewards.

evidence_limits: Evidence consists of user-provided Studio screenshots and the user-reported full contract address; no independent RPC or explorer verification was performed.
Successful state transitions are evidenced by Accepted-state reads. Their individual transaction IDs, execution receipts and finality were not supplied.
The two rejected attempts show FINALIZED / ERROR and Accepted consensus history. Acceptance and finalization do not mean successful execution.
The summary shown with the early cards rejection is timestamped 11:32, before the 11:33 error; it is not asserted to be a post-rejection read.
The deployed source, chain ID and deployment receipt were not independently verified. The recorded source SHA-256 belongs to the unchanged local file.
No complete get_plan output was supplied, so exact stored original rule text and per-rule evidence were not independently inspected. Rule text below records the instructed test inputs.
Two hosted interpretation outcomes are a bounded smoke check, not a live-model accuracy study, security audit or production-readiness finding.
The cards receipt displays two prerequisite hashes; the underlying wording/tables receipts were not separately fetched or cryptographically compared.
